title: Letters and Promise
author: Ulyana Zhou
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
